svg.title: Campbell River / Nootka Community Health Council
svg.desc: Reconstruction of the CR/N CHC mark from the supplied 527 by 507 pixel 2002 GIF. The orca uses editable Bézier forms, including forked fin and open jaw profiles, eight upper crowns and seven lower crowns. CR/N CHC uses five drawn glyphs. The island uses a registered GSHHS coastline. White service-area graphics and solid colours are visual estimates.
svg.metadata: Source: Campbell_River_Nootka_CHC_2002_original(1).gif in the supplied refinement package. Reconstructed for comparison and editing, November 2026. The source GIF supplied no original vector master, artist credit, or historical ink specifications. GSHHS/GSHHG geographic data attribution is retained from the supplied SVG.

g.inkscape:label: 02 • GSHHS geographic shoreline and approximate historical service area
g.data-source: GSHHS intermediate-resolution land polygons (Basemap bundled data); WGS84 to logo affine fit

g.data-evidence: Visual estimate of the white area in the supplied GIF. Historical jurisdiction is unverified.
